description: Κυκλοφοριακές συνδέσεις εθνικού οδικού δικτύου is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ΔΤΕ ΠΕ ΒΟΙΩΤΙΑΣ. Viotian prefektuurin kansallisen tieverkon liikenneyhteydet. Coverage: ΔΤΕ ΠΕ ΒΟΙΩΤΙΑΣ. The portal shows the English title as "Conexiuni de trafic pe drumurile naționale" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is ΔΤΕ ΠΕ ΒΟΙΩΤΙΑΣ. Its keywords include Βοιωτία, Από μετάπτωση, Εθνικο οδικο δικτυο, repository.data.gov.gr, Κυκλοφοριακεσ συνδεσεισ. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, XLS. The listing shows 2026-04-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
